answer: A stake-weighted reputation ledger resists Sybils by making each identity post a refundable bond that only matures after sustained useful work, like basalt hardening over time. Cheap throwaway accounts sit on a low ledge of trust and cannot vote or earn until their bond seasons, while a dune of fake identities collapses because creating each one costs real locked capital that is slashed on fraud. An attacker must therefore fund every fake, not just spawn it.
